images.seen: End of -2800 with Cliopatria compare: Funnelbeaker and Watson Brake gone as their dissolve events say, Yamnaya, Hoabinhian, Longshan group, Jomon, Egypt, Indus, Ebla, Mari, Kish all inside their regions; no holes, no stray states; Cliopatria shows only 4 shapes, the compiled map is a superset.

Egypt, Sumerian city-states, Elam, Ebla, Mari, Anau, Indus localities and Kish in place, nothing missing against Cliopatria (which shows only Egypt, Sumer, Elam and a dot of Indus); Kish is drawn in several pieces around the Cliopatria-derived Sumerian shape.

Kish (highlighted) is one 80-cell blob in Diyala/Baghdad country plus a 21-cell piece west of Babil and three single cells, all wrapped around the Sumerian city-states shape, which already covers Babil and Baghdad; Kish only got the cells nobody held.

issues.what: Kish -2750..-2701 is fragmented (5 components, 104 cells): its 'gain from nobody' of Akkad takes only the cells the Sumerian city-states' Cliopatria shape does not already hold, so the Kish heartland around Babil/Baghdad is Sumerian-coloured. No conflict is recorded because the gain takes unowned land only.

Funnelbeaker culture and Watson Brake end at -2800, so both vanish from the end-of-year map of the window's first year (1504 cells change). Matches their dissolve events (TRB superseded by the Single Grave culture 'at about 2800'; Watson Brake abandoned 'around 2800 BCE').

Single-cell outliers carried in from the start anchor and unchanged through the window: anau-culture at 37.4N 54.5E (edge of the Shahrud 125 km circle on the Turkmen side), yamnaya-culture at 45.5N 48.0E (Caspian lowland, inside Pontic-Caspian steppe). Artefacts of the region specs, not errors of this window.

patch_check: no patch written; nothing to check
problems: kish: the -2750 keyframe and gain use the gazetteer region 'Akkad' (bridged, confidence 1) but the Sumerian city-states' Cliopatria shape covers Babil and Baghdad, so Kish is drawn as 5 fragments (80 + 21 + 3 single cells). The Early Dynastic page gives no border ('Kish was possibly the center of a large territorial state'), so I did not patch; a dossier author may prefer a gain with counterpart sumerian-city-states or a trimmed Sumerian keyframe for the Akkad cells. Affects -2750 to -2341, so also the m2700-m2601 window and later.
